describes: the Asterism wire protocol as asterism 0.6.0 speaks it (docs/protocol.md)

values.note: every integer form of 1 is the same value
the largest integer every implementation carries
the smallest integer every implementation carries
float32 is read as a float (answered as float64)
a float with an integral value stays a float
CRuby writes str16 (compatibility mode), the boards str8; both are read
a str may carry bytes that are not UTF-8; they come back unchanged (binary data travels as str today: Review R-7)
keys are not limited to str (Review R-3)
CRuby reads bin as a binary String (answered as str ff00); the boards' MessagePack reads it as nil
CRuby carries it; mruby's Integer is int64 (the boards read -1)
no implementation gives ext a meaning

the class name and message of the exception the method raised

payload: no object nothing exposed by iut/conf

incoming.id: call returns what cannot be sent

arity -1: any number of arguments (exposed without counts)
